newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai soybeans end mostly down on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai soybeans end mostly down on profit-taking.

text.p: Shanghai soybean futures ended mostly down in slow trade on Friday on profit-taking by retail investors, traders said.
The most actively traded July 1997 contract ended at an intraday low of 3,365 yuan ($406) per tonne, losing 30 yuan. It opened at 3,385 yuan and hit a high of 3,405 yuan per tonne.
May rose nine to 3,389, September fell 38 to 3,380, November dropped 19 to 3,396, the January 1998 contract rose 30 to 3,405, and March fell five to 3,380 yuan.
Combined volume rose to 16,300 tonnes from 16,200 tonnes.
